profile.headline: Software Engineer | Python, AWS, FastAPI, Event-Driven Architectures, Typescript | AI/LLM, Backend and Data Engineering
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable cloud-native applications using Python and AWS. Experienced in backend development, API design, event-driven architectures, and high-throughput data pipelines, with additional expertise in AI/LLM systems and data engineering.

Key expertise:

Backend & APIs: Python (FastAPI, Flask), REST, GraphQL, microservices, authentication, rate limiting, caching
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, Batch, SQS, API Gateway), serverless, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure as code
Data & ETL Pipelines: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, DynamoDB, ETL/ELT pipelines, high-throughput batch & streaming data, performance optimization
AI & LLMOps: LLM integration, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, embeddings, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API, AWS Bedrock
Frontend Collaboration: Angular, TypeScript for building dashboards and analytics applications

I enjoy solving complex cloud, backend, and AI/ML challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering reliable, high-performance software that drives measurable business impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led full-stack development of critical features including Health Scorecard dashboard, Vacation Rental standardization module, and Portfolio Management system, handling end-to-end implementation from database design to UI development
•	Optimized ETL pipeline performance by 80% through strategic conversion of Batch Jobs to Array Jobs, significantly reducing processing time and AWS compute costs for data-intensive operations
•	Architected and implemented Open-Ended Rate Plans feature, enabling customers to specify rate ranges instead of individual daily rates, streamlining data submission workflows and improving operational efficiency
•	Built administrative tools and report formatters to support Customer Success and Data Science teams, enabling delivery of custom analytics reports and improving cross-team operational efficiency
•	Collaborated within Agile/Scrum framework as part of 5-person engineering team, contributing across all phases of SDLC from requirements gathering to production deployment and post-release support
•	Resolved complex production issues through systematic debugging and root cause analysis, demonstrating strong problem-solving skills and deep understanding of application architecture
positions.insights: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL), Software Design and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with senior developers to develop end-to-end e-commerce platform, implementing product catalog, shopping cart, and checkout functionality with secure payment integration
•	Successfully migrated Django application database from MySQL to PostgreSQL while maintaining complete data integrity and zero downtime during transition
•	Modernized client website by transitioning traditional server-rendered UI to React.js single-page application, preserving existing functionality while improving user experience and performance
•	Developed RESTful APIs using Python Flask for new features and collaborated with product team to resolve bugs and implement client requirements

volunteerExperiences.description: Managed more than 150+ students who participated in the 'CS-Coding-Games' event as part of GTU Techfest
Part of "Run for environment" marathon which was organized to spread awareness about pollution and global warming among citizens.

projects.title: LLM-Powered RAG Application
projects.description:
• Developed RAG-based Q&A system using LangChain with vector database integration (Pinecone), implementing document chunking,
embedding generation, and semantic search for knowledge retrieval with FastAPI backend exposing LLM capabilities through RESTful
endpoints.
• Creating React frontend with real-time chat interface, source attribution display, and AI explainability features to demonstrate model
reasoning and confidence scores.

projects.title: Blog Post (Tech - Python, Django, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap)
projects.description:
• Created a Web Application, where a user can create, read, update and delete their post. 
• Implemented the feature where user can reset their account password by getting email on their registered emailID.
